purpose: C6 + C5 (notes/008): public device information from the internet; no account, no API, no submission, no backend calibration snapshot

conventions.infidelity: Quantinuum quotes average gate infidelity from randomized benchmarking (RB); the 2-qubit 'Gate Error' on the Performance Validation page is the total error F_T = F_RB + L/D including leakage (D = 2).
conventions.spam: SPAM error = mean of the |0> and |1> prepare-and-measure error (Performance Validation page).
conventions.memory: 'Memory error per qubit at depth-1 circuit time' = idling/transport error per qubit per depth-1 layer, where a depth-1 layer = arbitrary permutation of all qubits + 1q and 2q gates on all floor(N/2) pairs of a maximally dense circuit (System Operation page).

p1_avg_infidelity.qualification: machine-specific RB, average over zones, includes leakage

p2_avg_infidelity.qualification: machine-specific 2Q RB at the fully entangling ZZ, F_T = F_RB + L/2, average over zones

memory_error_depth1.qualification: per qubit per depth-1 circuit time (transport-interleaved 1Q RB, includes the 1q gate error)

typical_product_sheet.qualification: 'Typical' column, H2 generation, average over zones

rzz_angle_dependence_paper.qualification: H2 at launch (2023), zone-averaged direct RB of U_ZZ(theta); not the current machine

T1.qualification: not published as a number for H2; hyperfine 171Yb+ clock qubit; idling error is published as memory error per depth-1 layer instead

T2.qualification: not published as a number for H2 (see memory error)

gate_durations.qualification: not published per gate; H2 paper Table 1 gives shot time 0.72 s for a 32-qubit RCS circuit with 172 2Q gates in 56 2Q gate rounds (17 ms/shot fixed overhead)

hqc_formula.value: HQC = 5 + C/5000 (N_1q + 10 N_2q + 5 N_m), C = shots, N_1q = PhasedX count (Rz excluded), N_2q = ZZ/RZZ count, N_m = measurements+resets+initialisations
hqc_formula.qualification: published on the Helios costing page as the HQC formula (Max(...) over shots for dynamic programs)

parallel_2q_operations.qualification: 8 gate zones for SPAM and 1q operations, 4 zones for 2q operations; 'This system requires 7 gating rounds to perform 2-qubit gates on all [N/2] pairs for a maximally dense circuit' (helios_ops)

native_gates.qualification: minimum RZZ angle 1e-4, minimum Rxy angle 3e-4 (smaller angles rounded to zero; helios_ops)

p1_avg_infidelity.qualification: Performance Validation '1-Qubit Gate Error 0.3e-04'; paper: 2.5(1)e-5 Clifford average infidelity

p2_avg_infidelity.qualification: paper Table 2: 7.9(2)e-4 (2QRB), 8.1(2)e-4 (cycle benchmarking); average over zones

memory_error_linear_depth1.qualification: paper: linear memory error rate 5(1)e-4 per depth-1 transport; nearly all of it is leakage (leakage rate 4.0(2)e-4)

memory_error_quadratic_depth1.qualification: paper: quadratic memory error parameter 7(2)e-5 (fit a + b l + c l^2 in the number l of depth-1 transports)

spam.qualification: standard measurement, average of |0> and |1>; paper: 8(1)e-4 (|0>) and 1.6(5)e-4 (|1>)

spam_1.qualification: standard measurement preparing |1> (leaked states read as 1, so this under-counts)

depth1_time.qualification: average depth-1 time per layer for a depth-10 random program on all 98 qubits (Fig. 4a)

gate_durations.qualification: per-gate durations not published; ground-state cooling ~3 ms (paper App.)

hqc_formula.value: same as H2 (HQC = 5 + C/5000 (N_1q + 10 N_2q + 5 N_m)); Helios jobs limited to 10 000 shots and 500 000 HQC

summary: p1 / p2: probability of a fault in a 1q / 2q gate, modelled mostly as asymmetric depolarizing channels; a fraction (p1_emission_ratio, p2_emission_ratio) is spontaneous emission instead: X 1/4, Y 1/4, leakage 1/2 of the time.
p_meas: classical bit-flip on measurement, separately for 0 and 1 outcomes; p_init: initialisation fault; crosstalk faults on MCMR.
RZZ(theta) depolarizing strength scales with angle: (przz_a |theta/pi|^przz_power + przz_b) p2, normalised so theta = pi/2 gives p2.

Memory (dephasing): Z noise during idling and transport, quadratic (coherent RZ(f d) in statevector mode, incoherent Pauli Z with probability sin^2(f d / 2) in stabilizer mode) and linear (Pauli Z with probability r d), d = duration.
Helios emulators add leakage/seepage; H2 emulators do not.
